acceptance: Every selected package row executes its direct application checks and every finite database fault case for its provider. A missing, failed, unavailable or interrupted case is not a pass.

apiComposition.scope: Actual cancellation, rollback, same PostgreSQL physical session, stream admission and early release, nullable composite relation, source/session cleanup, weak-reference release and native database owner counters.

referenceComposition.scope: Explicit migrations, static model/DTO mapping, typed CRUD/keyset queries, scoped idempotency, optimistic attachment changes, durable recovery, outbox deduplication, retention and protected filesystem references.

resourceObservationPolicy.databaseNativeOwners: nw_db_diagnostic_count_v1 kinds 0 through 5 from each selected provider module in ApiProbe.
resourceObservationPolicy.managedRoots: Explicit weak-reference and cleanup witnesses; no claim of a total GCHandle or root counter.
resourceObservationPolicy.faultMechanism: Only disposable verification processes and database traffic are faulted; packaged native assets are immutable.

historicalEvidence: Earlier B21/B22 records remain historical at their original commits. NativeWeave server/protocol checks and timed workloads have no current execution entry.
